title: Seasuite Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Seasuite has a prime Seaside, Florida location directly across from the beach (59 feet) and just one block to downtown Seaside Amphitheater area with over 35 shops and restaurants within walking distance to your front door! New modern guest cottage.
description_expanded: Description12 EAST RUSKIN STREET1 QUEEN, 1 QUEEN SLEEPER SOFAWelcome to Seasuite | A Steps-From-the-Sand Seaside EscapeWelcome to Seasuite, a modern guest cottage located directly across from the beach in Seaside, Florida, just 59 steps (59 feet) to the private beach access at East Ruskin Pavilion. This prime location places you only 450 feet—a two-minute walk—from downtown Seaside and the Seaside Amphitheater, with more than 40 shops and restaurants easily accessible right from your front door. Perfect for couples or small families, Seasuite offers a peaceful coastal retreat with unbeatable walkability. It may be rented on its own or together with the main home, Slow Mocean, for expanded accommodations.Private Guest Cottage with Thoughtful DesignAccess Seasuite via a sandy footpath that leads to your private guest cottage entrance. This newer construction home has been thoughtfully designed with modern finishes and coastal charm throughout. On the first floor, guests will find a comfortable queen bedroom complete with two large night stands, a small closet, two large shelves, and a mounted flat-screen TV. Just steps away is a full bathroom featuring a marble single vanity and a marble glass-enclosed walk-in shower, creating a spa-like feel for your stay.Modern Living Space & Kitchenette UpstairsThe second floor opens to a bright and inviting living space paired with a stylish kitchenette showcasing glass tile inlaid countertops. The kitchenette includes a bar sink, compact microwave, Bosch mini dishwasher, Keurig and drip coffee maker, toaster, and two refrigerator drawers (note: there is no freezer, stovetop, or oven). The adjacent living area features designer furnishings, a queen sleeper sofa, and a smart TV—ideal for relaxing after a day at the beach.Private Porch with Gulf BreezesDouble doors from the living room lead to a furnished open-air porch overlooking a shaded yard and scenic views along 30A. Sip your morning coffee or unwind in the evening while enjoying the sound of waves just steps away—an unmistakable Seaside experience.Added Conveniences for a Perfect StayAdditional amenities include a stackable washer and dryer and a private outdoor shower located just outside the front entrance—perfect for rinsing off after a beach day. With its exceptional location, thoughtful design, and effortless access to the beach and town center, Seasuite is an ideal coastal getaway for guests seeking comfort, privacy, and the magic of Seaside, Florida—all just steps from the Gulf.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES480 square feet1-minute walk, 59 feet to beach access at East Ruskin PavilionSeaside Private Residential Beach at East Ruskin Pavilion, largest private beaches on 30AKitchenette note: Compact refrigerator with two-drawer fridge; no freezerPeacock Alley Linens – Fresh, luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeResort-style amenities access: 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis & 3 pickle ball courts (ct. fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service with starter amenities providedParking policy: Only 1 parking pass is issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002086
